snippet.title: NumWorlds — Official PC Trailer | Out Now on Steam Early Access
snippet.description:
NumWorlds is now available on Steam Early Access. Add it to your wishlist while it's hot!

The objective is simple: Add numbers together by building chains to reach the target sum and solve puzzles in a relaxing 3D environment. Easy to learn, but genuinely difficult to master!

🎮 Wishlist now → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4792970/NumWorlds/
🌐 https://www.numworlds.com
🐦 https://x.com/NumWorlds

═══ THE GAME ═══

Every level presents a grid of number blocks set inside a handcrafted 3D world. Chain adjacent blocks together so they add up to the target, and clear the board. The rules take seconds to understand, but the puzzles reward patience, planning, and the occasional flash of inspiration.

There are over 200 levels, each one designed by hand across two biomes including some fun mini-games to refresh your brain from the intense mental maths sessions!

═══ TWO WORLDS TO EXPLORE ═══

🏛️ ATLANTIS: Solve your way through sunken ruins, where the pace is calm and the puzzles are quietly demanding. 100+ levels.

🦖 CRETACEOUS: Journey across jungles and volcanoes, where the difficulty rises with the terrain. 100+ levels.

The team is hard at work to bring you additional biomes in the near future!

═══ INFINITE MODE — NEW FOR PC ═══

Made for this release: procedurally generated puzzles with no timer, no game over, and no end. Just you, the numbers, and the chance to appear on our weekly and all-time Steam leaderboards. It has quickly become the mode we play the most ourselves!

═══ NUMWORLDS ON PC ═══

NumWorlds began on mobile, and is continuing its journey on PC. Same mechanics, new format!

In preparation for our Steam launch, we have reworked the game to make the PC experience feel fresh and rewarding with a few extra features:

🖱️ Native mouse, keyboard, and controller support
🖥️ Full widescreen with an interface redesigned for desktop
🏆 Steam achievements — including a few hidden ones worth hunting down

═══ EARLY ACCESS ═══

Everything above is playable today. We expect roughly 6 to 12 months to version 1.0, with new worlds, a deeper Infinite Mode, and more achievements along the way.

During this time, your feedback will shape the development of the official release of NumWorlds including upcoming game modes, mini-games and biomes. This game is as much ours as it is yours!

═══ ABOUT US ═══

We're Black Pug Studio, a small independent team based in Galway, Ireland. We chose Unreal Engine 5 for a number puzzle game because we believed the genre deserved worlds this beautiful. A year of players later, we still think we were right.

Pocket Gamer called NumWorlds "a beautiful brainteaser to chill and relax."

If you enjoyed the trailer, a wishlist or review makes a real difference to a team our size. Thank you for watching!

#NumWorlds #SteamEarlyAccess #PuzzleGame #IndieGame #PCGaming #UnrealEngine5 #CozyGame #NumberPuzzle #SteamGames #IndieGaming
